name: agent-fix-timeline
title: Fix timeline
author: Eduardo Retana
description: A host-fed timeline of diagnosis, files, edit, tests, and push. It does not run an agent.

meta.descriptionEs: Diagnóstico, archivos, edición, pruebas y empuje. Los pasos los manda el anfitrión.

examples.title: Marco de estrés
examples.description: 390 px y un camino de archivo de 60 caracteres.

meta.usage: <AgentFixTimeline steps={[{ id: "1", kind: "thought", label: "The folio dropped", status: "done" }]} />

api.name: steps
api.description: kind is thought, edit, test, push, or done. files are optional.

api.name: variant
api.description: rail is the default vertical spine.

api.name: labels
api.description: English by default. agentFixTimelineLabelsEs is es-MX.

docs: Clean-room. Idea only, no license (Phil Pitus, Generative UI #6). Steps arrive as props. There is no agent in this file. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive. No theme. English labels are the default; agentFixTimelineLabelsEs is es-MX.
